changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led support triage, grounded reply, optional escalation, delivery, and observed closure contract.

title: Support Case to Reviewed Resolution
description: Route an authorized customer case through sourced triage, a grounded unsent reply or owned escalation, and provider-backed follow-through.
setup_prompt: Use Support Case to Reviewed Resolution as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Support Crews, helpdesk or inbox source, current case threads, approved knowledge, priority and escalation policy, customer contact rules, provider delivery route, and case outcome source. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifact validators, owner approvals, and one manual case. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection alone does not update a case, page a team, send a response, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized helpdesk, inbox, or case export
Priority, response deadline, duplicate, and escalation rules
Current approved help content and product or incident sources
Recipient, channel, claim, and message approval rules
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing Support Crews with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded case artifact

recommended_tools.name: Helpdesk or inbox connection
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current case, thread, prior reply, owner and status records

recommended_tools.name: Approved help center or knowledge export
recommended_tools.purpose: Ground customer-facing claims in current approved content

recommended_tools.name: Incident or issue source
recommended_tools.purpose: Check escalation owner acceptance and affected service state

recommended_tools.name: Helpdesk delivery channel
recommended_tools.purpose: Send an exact approved reply and retain provider receipt through a separate authorized route

pulse_focus.label: Support case resolution
focus_areas: Whether urgent cases receive the correct owner and current evidence
Whether reviewed replies and escalations lead to observed case outcomes without duplicate contact
review_when: An SLA approaches, a customer replies, an escalation changes owner, or a case outcome is observed

outputs: Reviewed Support Crew roster and case source map
Validated support triage and grounded unsent reply
Optional accepted escalation with owner and deadline
Provider-confirmed delivery and observed case outcome when authorized
Manual route evidence, action ledger, and activation choice
